Council Meetings

Council meetings will typically be held the third Wednesday of the month (excluding January where no meeting is typically held). Council meetings normally commence at 5.00pm to afford an opportunity for most members of the public to attend after work, with November and December meetings normally commencing at 6.00pm to afford the opportunity for members to attend during the harvest period.

Notice of 2026 Council Meetings

Any changes are advertised through the website, the Shire's social media and noticeboards. 

Special Council Meetings are held as required. These will also be advertised as required.

Meetings are open to ratepayers and residents who are more than welcome to attend.
